result.summary: Narrow invoice/quote workflow for Spanish freelancers: sell a clean quote-to-invoice generator and template pack instead of a broad SaaS or generic service.
result.opportunity: Spanish freelancers and micro-studios create quotes and invoices manually, while tax authority rules require formal invoices and clear payment terms. The task is repetitive, administrative, and easy to package into a fixed-scope digital product with immediate usage for a specific professional niche.
result.target_customer: Spanish independent freelancers and micro-studios (designers, developers, consultants, copywriters, photographers, agencies with 1-10 people) who send proposals and invoices to clients on a regular basis.
result.offer: A productized invoice and quote generator for Spanish freelancers: quote-to-PDF/HTML invoice workflow, VAT fields, branding, payment terms, due dates, and export-ready template pack with a simple setup guide.
result.price: 149 EUR for the generator pack; 249 EUR with branded white-label setup or extra templates
result.why_now: Spain's tax authority publishes VAT invoice guidance and obligations for private businesses, while public freelance marketplaces show sustained demand for invoice template and invoice generator searches. This is a common professional workflow, easy to explain, and fast to validate without building a broad platform.
actions_completed: Reviewed playbook routes #14 and adjacent productized-service patterns.
Inspected recent IAMO attempts to avoid saturated local-review and Shopify-feed patterns.
Verified public external market demand through official Spanish tax authority guidance and public Fiverr searches for invoice template/generator offers.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to Spanish freelancers and micro-studios via public portfolio/contact pages or LinkedIn, with a 2-minute demo and direct CobrAMO payment link.
execution_packet.subject: Quick quote + invoice workflow for your freelance business
execution_packet.message: Hola [Nombre], vi que tu estudio/empresa trabaja con presupuestos y facturas para clientes. En España, gestionar presupuestos y facturas es un trabajo repetitivo y con obligaciones formales. He preparado un ejemplo muy concreto de generador de presupuestos/facturas para autónomos: plantillas exportables a PDF/HTML, IVA, condiciones de pago, branding y flujo rápido para enviar al cliente. Lo ofrezco por 149 EUR con una entrega simple y sin dependencia de un dashboard pesado. Si te interesa, te mando un demo de 2 minutos y un ejemplo de 1 proyecto. Referencia: RANK-IAMO514. Puedes pagar en CobrAMO: https://cobramo.netlify.app/
execution_packet.deliverable: A packaged quote-to-invoice generator with template set, Spanish invoice fields, branding controls, and a 1-page setup guide; delivered as editable files and a hosted demo link if needed.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided the saturated local-review, GBP and Shopify repair patterns. This shift is narrower and lower-friction: a focused productized tool aimed at a legal/admin pain with obvious professional value and a single-country test (Spain freelance invoicing). It fits route #14 and the 'obvious daily workflow' lesson from Pocket: repeated use, professional buyer, low complexity, and clear utility.
result.next_step: Find 15-20 Spanish freelancers or micro-studios with public portfolios and direct contact details; send one personalized note with one specific pain point (manual quote/invoice work) and a 2-minute demo; if they respond, close the first 149 EUR pack through CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO514.
result.notes: The playbook routes considered: #14 Invoice or quote generator was the strongest fit. I rejected #34, #54, #74 and #94 because the current external evidence and validation speed favor a narrow template/generator product for a specific country/profession rather than broader SEO, PWA, affiliate tutorial, or crypto integration work. No real payment or revenue was generated in this execution.
